nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for privileged functions.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances, updated with unchecked arithmetic in several functions.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances.
Mapping(address => bool) whitelist that lets an address bypass the transfer restriction checks in ensure().
Mapping(address => uint256) counting how many restricted sales an address has performed.
Minimum sale amount in token units, enforced by condition().
Maximum sale amount in token units, enforced by condition().
Maximum number of restricted sales allowed per address, enforced by condition().
Address granted a whitelist bypass in ensure(); changeable by the owner through setTradeAddress().
Public constant decimals = 18 used for scaling amounts with 10**decimals.
Public total token supply, minted to the deployer.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address allowed to bypass the transfer restriction in ensure().
External payable ERC20 transfer entrypoint that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that grants whitelist bypasses via owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise calls condition().
External payable transfer entrypoint that checks allowance, applies ensure(), and mutates balanceOf with unchecked + and - operations.
External payable approval entrypoint that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-value race protection.
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
Privileged minting function that sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) and whitelists the recipient.
Owner-only function setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch distribution that multiplies _value by _tos.length and loops crediting recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Pure Uniswap pair-address derivation using keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...)) and the init code hash.
Deployer constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender and an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Internal ERC20 transfer in the base ERC20 contract using SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
Internal ERC20 approval that writes _allowances and emits Approval.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
SafeERC20 private helper performing a low-level call to the token address and decoding the returned bool.
Address library helper using inline assembly extcodehash to test whether an account is a contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for access control checks, allowanced lookups and balance ownership.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(): arbitrary target and calldata executed in the contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom(): unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom(): unchecked addition without SafeMath.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend(): unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend(): unchecked multiplication without SafeMath.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) in _mints(): unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn(): unchecked external low-level call with reentrancy surface.
Inline assembly codehash:= extcodehash(account) in Address.isContract().
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(factory, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(token0, token1)), initCodeHash)) in pairFor().
Address parameter _from shared by transferFrom(), ensure() and condition(); controls whose allowance and balance are read/written.
Address parameter _to in transfer()/transferFrom()/ensure(); recipient whose balance is credited.
Uint parameter _value in transfer()/transferFrom()/ensure()/condition(); amount moved and validated.
Address parameter _spender in approve(); key of the allowance being overwritten.
Address parameter a in delegate(); target of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Bytes parameter b in delegate(); calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Address parameter spender in _mints(); recipient credited by the minting balance assignment.
Uint256 parameter addedValue in _mints(); multiplied by 10**decimals and written to balanceOf.
Uint256 parameter saleNum in init(); stored into _saleNum.
Uint256 parameter token in init(); scaled by 10**decimals and stored into _minSale.
Uint256 parameter maxToken in init(); scaled by 10**decimals and stored into _maxSale.
Address array parameter _tos in batchSend(); recipients of the batch distribution.
Uint parameter _value in batchSend(); per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length.
Address parameter addr in setTradeAddress(); becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Address parameter factory in pairFor(); factory address packed into the pair hash.
Address parameter tokenA in pairFor(); sorted and packed into the pair hash.
Address parameter tokenB in pairFor(); sorted and packed into the pair hash.
Local uint total in batchSend() holding _value * _tos.length before deducting the sender's balance.
Local address _to inside the batchSend() loop; each credited recipient.
Local loop counter i in batchSend().

edges.reason: transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from and reads allowance[_from][msg.sender], so the caller controls the allowance path.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_mints() gates minting on msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address.
init() gates parameter setting on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() gates distribution on msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender's balance.
setTradeAddress() gates the tradeAddress whitelist update on msg.sender == owner.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when no whitelist bypass applies.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address used as a whitelist bypass.
approve() writes allowances through the internal _approve().
ERC20 transfer paths interact with the internal _approve/_transfer accounting helpers.
_from indexes the balanceOf slot that is decremented without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] with unchecked arithmetic, allowing underflow.
_from's debited amount must match the _to credit, both unchecked.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic, allowing overflow.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] directly.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] to count restricted sales.
condition() reads _minSale to bound _value.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound _value.
condition() reads _saleNum when comparing against _onSaleNum[_from].
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass of the sale restrictions.
ensure() reads tradeAddress to grant a whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads owner to grant a whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads the constant UNI router address to grant a bypass.
_value (batch amount basis) reaches balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total via the unchecked multiplication.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow of total.
addedValue is scaled by 10**decimals and written with unchecked multiplication.
The caller-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall.
The caller-supplied bytes b is the calldata of the delegatecall.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) against this contract's storage.
callOptionalReturn() performs the low-level token call.
The external low-level call transfers control to the token contract, which could re-enter before state settles.
isContract() executes the inline assembly extcodehash opcode.
pairFor() computes the pair address with keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...)).
Elements of _tos are copied into the loop-local _to for crediting.
Loop index i selects each element of _tos as _to.
init() writes the scaled token parameter into _minSale.
init() writes the scaled maxToken parameter into _maxSale.
init() writes saleNum into _saleNum.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled addedValue.
batchSend() debits and credits balanceOf entries in a loop.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
_spender is the key written by approve().
spender indexes the balanceOf slot written by the unchecked mint multiplication.
saleNum parameter is stored by init().
token parameter is scaled and stored by init().
maxToken parameter is scaled and stored by init().
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
factory parameter is packed into the pair hash.
tokenA is sorted and packed into the keccak pair hash.
tokenB is sorted and packed into the keccak pair hash.
_to is credited inside transferFrom().

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a data-only parameter consumed by transferFrom()'s allowance and balance lookups.
_to is a data-only recipient parameter credited inside transferFrom().
_value is a data-only amount parameter that feeds the unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
_spender is only a key used when approve() writes the allowance mapping.
a is the raw delegatecall target supplied to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
b is the raw calldata supplied to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
spender is only used by _mints() to index balanceOf and canSale.
addedValue is the multiplicand of the unchecked mint scaling operation.
saleNum is a plain value parameter stored by init() into _saleNum.
token is a plain value parameter scaled and stored by init() into _minSale.
maxToken is a plain value parameter scaled and stored by init() into _maxSale.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by the batchSend() distribution loop.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked _value * _tos.length operation.
addr is used only to overwrite the tradeAddress whitelist state in setTradeAddress().
factory is used only as a packed input to the pair derivation in pairFor().
tokenA is sorted and hashed inside the pair derivation operation.
tokenB is sorted and hashed inside the pair derivation operation.
total is the intermediate value deducted from balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend().
_to is the per-iteration recipient temporary used by the batchSend() loop.
i is the sole loop counter driving the batchSend() iteration.
